name: diagrams
description: Draw themeable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as standalone HTML with inline SVG

interface.shortDescription: Draw themeable architecture and flow diagrams as HTML
interface.longDescription: One skill, creating-diagrams, that draws architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams as self-contained HTML with inline SVG, light and dark modes, and SVG/PNG export. Colors come only from theme variables, and themes can be derived from a presentations preset or a PowerPoint template so diagrams match a corporate brand.
defaultPrompt: Draw an architecture diagram of this repository
